cli.adapters.matrix.stacks.intro: A stack adapter reads the routes of the API, their guards, the screens or behaviour hints of a framework (`{command} facts`: sources `api`, `screens`, `behaviours`). It counts as reading a language once the application uses its stack: one of the dependencies or files of the third column.
cli.adapters.matrix.deps.intro: Every manifest and lock file below is read on its own, four folders deep at most (source `dependencies`). With `--network`, only the public names of npm and PyPI are ever sent to their registry; the other ecosystems are read offline.
cli.adapters.matrix.lowcode.intro: Detected, never read: `{command} inputs status` and the facts say so, and the agents read the export themselves (an unpacked Power Apps app, an OutSystems module, a Salesforce project…).
cli.adapters.matrix.languages.intro: Each language of the code, and what reads it. A language read by nobody here is measured (its files and lines, source `stack`) and told to the agents, who read that code themselves.
cli.adapters.matrix.agents: not read: the agents read it
cli.adapters.matrix.infra.intro: An infra adapter reads what infrastructure files declare (source `infra`): cloud resources, workloads, images, environments — names and a few settings, never a value or a secret.
